instruction: Add durable HTTP idempotency support to POST /api/users/ in this FastAPI/SQLAlchemy service. Accept an optional Idempotency-Key header. The first keyed request must preserve the existing HTTP 201 response. Replaying the same key with the same canonical JSON payload must return the original status and exactly the original JSON response without creating a second user. Reusing the key with a different payload must return HTTP 409. The guarantee must survive application process restarts and concurrent duplicate requests, so an in-memory-only cache is not acceptable. Requests without the header must retain existing behaviour. Use the existing SQLite/SQLAlchemy architecture, keep the user creation and idempotency outcome transactionally safe, validate or bound unreasonable keys, add meaningful public tests, and document the contract and operational limitations in README.md. Do not weaken or delete existing tests.
